d:
A celestial humanoid species with a graceful build and a face of serene maturity. The hair is long and wavy, colored a shimmering platinum white and adorned with a gold headpiece. The eyes are calm and glowing with a soft gold light. The outfit is a flowing gown of pristine white with gold armor accents on the shoulders and chest. The design features two large, feathered white wings on the back. 5 fingers per hand.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
